name: bamboo
subtitle_source: Factory paint sheets and colour chart (1966-1983)
notes: Cards cover each year's full line; only the chips of the 4x4 utility model are picked by hand in card_layout.json. Several sheets are byte-identical across years, so a chip is sampled once from the clearest sheet and repeated for every year it was offered (carried_over_from).
1966-72 colours and years come from the card's own model table for these years (sources/1966-bamboo-pg03.jpg); card spellings are used for names (the table misspells Cygnus, Muleta, Appenino).

1973-77 years and the colours 304, 541, 031, 632, 637, 854, 1654 come from a community chart (importarchive.com, IH8MUD), not from the maker. chart.json holds that chart (colours, years, example-photo links) in full.

The colours were reviewed one by one against the chart, the card chips and real-car photos (colour_decisions.json holds the picks). Most picks are the chart's own flat colour; where a swatch has a chip, the card scan is kept as measured_hex.

The card library ends in 1977: the 1978-83 years and the colours 033, 464, 532, 653, 681, 6L4, 857 come from the chart alone (no chip on any card), so their swatches are hex-only rows in card_layout.json (card_file empty).
1964-65 cards are used only as chip sources (T-451, T-452, T-453, T-1028, T-1208); the card has no model year table for 1964-65.
